notes:
v2.3.4 is a bug-fix release. Please update before lodging your BAS for the July-September quarter.

BAS: credit notes and voided invoices now come off total sales (G1) and GST on sales (1A); voided bills come off GST on purchases (1B). On the cash basis, each payment now carries only its share of the GST, so invoices paid in instalments or reduced by a credit note are no longer overstated, and Point of Sale refunds come off in the period they are paid out.

Invoices with several lines or a discount no longer post a journal that is 1c out of balance.

New company files can save items straight away without restarting Dogbox.

If you have already run a BAS for this quarter, run it again after updating.
